idea-plugin.name: Unsafe Deserialization Sink Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject() call inside a Spring MVC/JAX-RS endpoint method whose constructor argument traces back (within the same method, one direct hop) to an untrusted parameter -- CWE-502, Deserialization of Untrusted Data, one of the most-cited OWASP Top 10 categories for Java, a real path to remote code execution via gadget chains.

Same source-to-sink principle CodeQL uses for this exact category, implemented with PSI alone -- no external analysis engine, no CI pipeline. CodeQL covers this as a batch/CI query, not an inline IDE inspection; no Marketplace plugin found with this specific mechanism.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only follows the data within the SAME method and one direct hop to a parameter -- never crosses more than one method of distance. The untrusted source is a closed list of known Spring MVC/JAX-RS controller signatures, not a general taint analysis of the whole project.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
